Orthodontics · Patient guide

Clear aligners in Gujranwala

Clear aligners use a series of removable trays to move teeth in planned stages.

Ask about an appointment →

When might I need it?

Consider an assessment for spacing or crowding. Some bite or movement needs are better managed with fixed braces, so the dentist will compare the options.

What age group is it for?

They can be considered for adults and selected teenagers who can follow the wear schedule. Tooth development and oral health are assessed first.

What happens at the appointment?

Records or scans support the plan. You wear each tray as instructed and attend progress visits. Some cases need tooth-coloured attachments or additional trays.

Does it hurt?

A new tray can feel tight and may cause temporary pressure. Tell the clinic if a tray is painful, damaged or not seating as expected.

How much does it cost?

The number of trays, refinements, records and retainers can affect the price. Ask which are included and how replacement trays are handled.

For current pricing and availability, ask the clinic for a quote in PKR based on your assessment.

Plan your visit

Ask the team about availability, the consultation fee, and what to bring. Wait for reception to confirm the date and time.
